IShoppingAttributeValue.IRequest.description: Request DTO for searching attribute values within a dimension in the shopping mall catalog. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination for catalog administrators and sellers.

IShoppingAttributeValue.ICreate.description:
DTO for adding a new attribute value under the specified attribute dimension (identified by dimension_code in the operation path). The absence of a shopping_attribute_dimension_id property is intentional; the parent dimension context is determined from the dimensionCode path parameter in the API, not in the payload. This schema is to be used exclusively with endpoints that already identify the attribute dimension via context. 

Required fields: value_code (must be unique within the dimension) and display_value. display_order and description are optional. Use by catalog administrators to enrich available attribute (variant) choices for products and SKUs. Description is for admin/internal documentation only; never presented to end users.

value_code.description: Unique value_code for this attribute value within the selected attribute dimension. Must be lowercase, business-specified, and unique in (dimension_code, value_code) scope for the targeted dimension. Ex: 'blue', 'small', 'vegan'. This is not updatable after creation.

display_value.description: Display string for this attribute value, used in customer-facing filters, selectors, and PDP options. Example: 'Blue', 'Small', 'Vegan'. Required. Should be meaningful, short, and display-appropriate.

oneOf.description: Optional integer for UI/admin display priority among values in this dimension. Null means unspecified or system-decided.

display_order.description: Optional integer for UI/admin display priority among values in this dimension. Null means unspecified or system-decided.

oneOf.description: Optional admin/catalog manager documentation of the attribute value's business context, internal code mapping, or legacy reference. Not intended for customer display or catalog faceting.

description.description: Optional admin/catalog manager documentation of the attribute value's business context, internal code mapping, or legacy reference. Not intended for customer display or catalog faceting.

IShoppingAttributeValue.IUpdate.description: DTO for updating details of an attribute value within a given attribute dimension. This schema does not include value_code or shopping_attribute_dimension_id—both are immutable and provided via endpoint path context. The only updatable fields are display_value (customer/public label), display_order (for admin/UI sort order), and description (internal/admin notes). Use this schema for catalog/admin operations to update display labels, adjust order precedence, or clarify admin documentation of the value. Updates to value_code or the parent attribute dimension are not permitted; these are fixed by creation context.

display_value.description: Display string for this attribute value, shown to customers in filters, selectors, or product detail/options. Nullable in updates; if omitted, retains the previous value. Must be meaningful and short.

oneOf.description: Optional integer for managed UI/admin display order among sibling values. Null means default or unspecified order.

display_order.description: Optional integer for managed UI/admin display order among sibling values. Null means default or unspecified order.

oneOf.description: Optional admin/catalog documentation or context for this attribute value. This is not visible to end-users; for catalog/business reference only. Null clears documentation.

description.description: Optional admin/catalog documentation or context for this attribute value. This is not visible to end-users; for catalog/business reference only. Null clears documentation.

product_code.description: Unique business code for the parent product (corresponds to shopping_products.code). Used as the search context. Required, globally unique.

search.description: Textual filter for fuzzy search (optional).

oneOf.description: Sorting direction. Must be 'asc' or 'desc'. (optional)
Sorting direction. Must be 'asc' or 'desc'. (optional)

page.description: Page number (default: 1) (optional).

limit.description: Max page size (default: 20, max: 100) (optional).

IShoppingProductImage.IRequest.description: Query for filtering, searching, sorting and paging product images for a given product business code.

IShoppingProductImage.ICreate.description: Create DTO for uploading a new product image to a product owned by the authenticated seller or admin. Represents an image file addition for shopping_product_images, enforcing allowed formats (JPEG/PNG), a maximum 5MB size, and ownership/business constraints. The operation uses product context (provided by path/parent), so no direct product ID/code field is included; only image attributes are accepted. The order_index is optional and assigned by business logic if omitted.

image_uri.description: URI for the image file being uploaded (expected post-upload location, NOT a raw file or multipart body; the backend must receive the file, store it, and record its URI here). Only JPEG or PNG (by business logic), max 5MB enforced by service. Required.

order_index.description: Optional zero-based display order for this image among the product's images. If omitted, the backend assigns the appropriate order index automatically based on current sequence. Not required when uploading a single image or if default sorting is acceptable.

IShoppingProductImage.IUpdate.description: Update DTO for replacing or modifying the attributes of a product image in shopping_product_images. Used for admin/seller-led edits to file URI (image replacement), display order, or future metadata. Only the image_uri, order_index, or new display/metadata fields (as schema evolves) may be supplied. File validation (JPEG/PNG, ≤5MB) and ownership are enforced. No product or image ID is present (these are part of URL/path context for REST). All properties are optional—partial updates supported.

image_uri.description: Replacement URI for the uploaded image file (JPEG or PNG, ≤5MB enforced by backend; supplied as a URI to new location after upload). Nullable to allow PATCH semantics (clear image if needed by business logic).

order_index.description: Optional new image display order (zero-based) among the product's images. Backend will re-sort accordingly. May be omitted when not changing sort order.

page.description: Pagination: page number (starts from 1, defaults to 1 if not provided).

limit.description: Pagination: number of items per page (default 20, max 100).

sort_by.description: Sorting field - valid values: tag_code, display_value, created_at, updated_at.

oneOf.description: Sort order: asc for ascending, desc for descending.
Sort order: asc for ascending, desc for descending.

order.description: Sort order: asc for ascending, desc for descending.

search.description: Full-text search across tag code, display value, and description.

display_value.description: Filter: display name for tag (exact match or partial search).

description.description: Filter: description, for partial or full-text search.

IShoppingProductTag.IRequest.description: Request parameters for searching and filtering product tags on the shopping mall platform, as defined by the 'shopping_product_tags' table. Supports pagination, sort, and flexible filters for admin-side tag curation and audit workflows.

id.description: Primary key (UUID) of the product tag as stored in 'shopping_product_tags' table.

tag_code.description: Business code/slug for the tag (must be unique). Used for business/engineering lookup, product assignment, and global referencing.

display_value.description: Displayed tag name (e.g., 'Eco-Friendly'). Parameter used in listings, search UI, and tag-driven navigation.

description.description: Human-readable description or documentation of the tag’s purpose; shown to admins, catalog managers, and analytics workflows.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp (UTC, ISO8601), auto-assigned when the tag is created in the catalog.

IShoppingProductTag.description: Full metadata and catalog/business details for a single product tag, as defined in 'shopping_product_tags'. Includes unique tag code, display name, description, and creation audit timestamp. Used for business management, catalog curation, and filtering throughout the commerce platform.

tag_code.description: Business code/slug for the tag (must be unique). Used for catalog, filtering, and search. (shopping_product_tags.tag_code)

display_value.description: Displayed tag name (e.g., 'Eco-Friendly'). Used in product search and filter displays. (shopping_product_tags.display_value)

description.description: Description/purpose of this tag. Used for catalog management and business context. (shopping_product_tags.description)

IShoppingProductTag.ICreate.description: Fields required to create a new product tag. Maps directly to shopping_product_tags (tag_code, display_value, description). Business validation rules apply to ensure tag_code uniqueness, proper display semantics, and catalog-oriented context. All fields are required and validated according to catalog metadata best practices.

display_value.description: Displayed tag name (e.g., 'Eco-Friendly'). May be updated by admins for search or curation alignment. (shopping_product_tags.display_value)

description.description: Description/purpose of this tag. May be refined for clarity or platform documentation. (shopping_product_tags.description)

IShoppingProductTag.IUpdate.description: Fields for updating an existing product tag. Only display_value and description may be changed in-place. tag_code is immutable via this operation. Fields map directly to shopping_product_tags and must comply with catalog business rules, including character limits and content guidelines. This DTO is used by admin-level operations and only updates the allowed metadata properties.

IShoppingInventory.IRequest.description: Filter, search, and pagination parameters for inventory (shopping_inventory) search operations. Allows admin and seller to query SKU stock for operational management, replenishment, and reporting scenarios. Follows established search DTO pattern, supporting keyword, id, quantity, and sorting constraints. Does NOT expose direct actor (seller) filtering in open requests—must bind to valid context on backend. See business rules for max/min constraints and result shaping.

page.description: Requested results page (1-based index, default: 1). Must be >= 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of items per page of results. Bounded by platform constraint (default: 20, max: 100).

sku_code.description: Filter to exact matching SKU code. Case-insensitive, must be globally unique. Uses shopping_skus.sku_code.

product_code.description: Filter to exact parent product code. Uses shopping_products.code.

seller_id.description: Filter by seller's unique identifier. Uses shopping_sellers.id.

keyword.description: Free-text search term for SKUs/products. Matches SKU code, product name, or associated tag.

IShoppingInventory.description:
Represents the authoritative, real-time inventory state for each SKU. Central source of current stock count and status per SKU. Used by admin and sellers to monitor, manage, and report the platform's sellable inventory. Quantities are always non-negative. Modification occurs only via inventory adjustment APIs, which append to adjustment logs for audit and compliance. Linked to a globally unique SKU and associated product context. May be soft deleted when a SKU is archived or deprecated. See also: shopping_inventory_adjustments for full ledger of changes.

This schema is used for read operations (inventory lookup, reporting, monitoring) and must comply with business logic prohibiting direct writes to this entity outside controlled flows.

id.description: Primary key for shopping_inventory row. System-assigned UUID value.

shopping_sku_id.description: SKU entity this inventory record tracks. References shopping_skus.id. One-to-one with inventory record.

quantity.description: Current available units of inventory for the SKU. Must be greater than or equal to zero. Updates triggered by adjustments only.

created_at.description: Timestamp marking initial inventory record creation.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when inventory last changed (including adjustment event, reconciliation).

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion/audit retention. Populated if SKU is archived/discontinued, null if active.

sku.description: SKU entity corresponding to this inventory record. Provides code, price, product context data. Reference object (not id only).

product.description: Parent product entity for which this inventory entry is defined. Reference object for display/report.

IShoppingInventoryAdjustment.IRequest.description: DTO schema for querying and filtering inventory adjustment history for a specific SKU. Supports advanced search operations, including filtering by actor type (customer, seller, admin, system), date range, adjustment amount/range, reason code, and context note. Designed for use in paginated audit log requests for a SKU. Only users with inventory management or audit rights may use this DTO.

page.description: Page number to retrieve; used for pagination. Must be a positive integer (default is 1).

limit.description: Max number of adjustment records per page. Default is 20, maximum is 100.

actor_type.description: Type of actor that performed inventory adjustments to filter by. One of: 'customer', 'seller', 'admin', or 'system'. Optional.

reason_code.description: Reason code for adjustment event to filter by. Optional, supports exact match or partial search if implemented by backend.

date_from.description: ISO8601 timestamp for lower bound (inclusive) of adjustment event creation time, in UTC. Optional.

date_to.description: ISO8601 timestamp for upper bound (inclusive) of adjustment event creation time, in UTC. Optional.

adjustment_min.description: Filter: inclusive minimum delta of adjustment_amount (can be negative for stock decreases). Optional.

adjustment_max.description: Filter: inclusive maximum delta of adjustment_amount (can be negative for stock decreases). Optional.

context.description: Free-text search within the adjustment's context note or explanation. Optional.

oneOf.description: Field to sort adjustment records by. Either 'created_at' (timestamp, default) or 'adjustment_amount'.
Field to sort adjustment records by. Either 'created_at' (timestamp, default) or 'adjustment_amount'.

sort_by.description: Field to sort adjustment records by. Either 'created_at' (timestamp, default) or 'adjustment_amount'.

oneOf.description: Sort direction (ascending or descending). Defaults to 'desc'.
Sort direction (ascending or descending). Defaults to 'desc'.

sort_direction.description: Sort direction (ascending or descending). Defaults to 'desc'.

IShoppingInventoryAdjustment.ICreate.description: DTO for creating a new inventory adjustment in the inventory audit log. Used for stock changes such as restocking, manual adjustment, business/process corrections, or system-driven events. Must specify SKU code, adjustment amount (+/- units), reason code, actor type, and may include optional context note or reference. Adjustments resulting in negative quantity are strictly rejected by business rules. Every adjustment is immutably recorded for compliance, operational traceability, and auditing. Only sellers (with rights on their SKUs), admins, or system actors can create adjustments. DO NOT include before/after quantities—these are computed on the backend.

sku_code.description: Globally unique business code identifying the SKU whose inventory should be adjusted (maps to shopping_skus.sku_code in catalog). Required.

adjustment_amount.description: Delta to apply to inventory: positive for restocking/increase, negative for deduction/withdrawal (sale/refund/correction). Must not create negative inventory. Required.

reason_code.description: Invariant, business-defined constant code for the reason of this adjustment (e.g., 'order_sale','manual_restock','refund','correction','system'). Must follow business enum or naming policy. Required.

oneOf.description: Class of actor performing the adjustment event. Must be one of: 'customer','seller','admin','system'. Required.
Class of actor performing the adjustment event. Must be one of: 'customer','seller','admin','system'. Required.
Class of actor performing the adjustment event. Must be one of: 'customer','seller','admin','system'. Required.
Class of actor performing the adjustment event. Must be one of: 'customer','seller','admin','system'. Required.

actor_type.description: Class of actor performing the adjustment event. Must be one of: 'customer','seller','admin','system'. Required.

context_note.description: Free-form text explaining the context or business event for the adjustment, such as order ID, refund details, anomaly, or operator comment. Optional.

IShoppingInventoryAdjustment.description:
Represents an atomic adjustment to the inventory of a specific SKU in the shopping mall system. Each adjustment records a before/after state, the change in quantity, the actor performing the change, the business reason behind the adjustment (such as manual restock, order, refund, anomaly, or system correction), and an immutable timestamp. This schema is crucial for audit compliance, operational traceability, and fraud prevention. It follows a strict append-only ledger model: every inventory event (increase, decrease, or administrative correction) must be recorded using this schema to support real-time stock status and historical analysis.

Related Prisma model: shopping_inventory_adjustments. Every property here corresponds to a field in that model, and is fully documented for audit, compliance, and analytics.

This object is used as the response from inventory adjustment creation APIs and for system-level reporting/business dashboards.

id.description: Primary key (UUID) for this adjustment record. Used for referencing this immutable log entry.

shopping_inventory_id.description: Reference to the precise inventory record being adjusted (shopping_inventory.id), which is always linked to a unique SKU. Required for cross-checking aggregate stock with ledger history.

shopping_sku_id.description: Unique ID for the SKU entity (shopping_skus.id) to which this adjustment applies. Direct mapping to the SKU whose stock is changing.

actor_type.description: Polymorphic string to record the actor class performing the adjustment (e.g., 'customer', 'seller', 'admin', or 'system'). Used for audit, permission enforcement, and analytics.

actor_id.description: UUID of the involved actor (user/admin/seller/system). No foreign key: stored as a simple UUID for immutable audit history. This enables tracing all inventory events to an accountable entity across all actor types.

reason_code.description: Business code describing why this adjustment occurred (e.g., 'order', 'refund', 'manual', 'restock', 'correction'). Used for analytics, audit, and operational business rules.

quantity_before.description: The stock value (units) prior to this adjustment. Enables precise tracing and rollback analysis.

quantity_after.description: Post-adjustment stock value after this event was applied. Used for consistency, business validation, and fast lookup.

adjustment_amount.description: The difference applied to the inventory: quantity_after = quantity_before + adjustment_amount. Can be positive (restock), negative (sale/return), or zero (correction/anomaly/no-op).

oneOf.description: Optional freeform context/note for this adjustment (such as manual restock batch label, order ID, administrator comment, anomaly fix, etc.). Used for additional traceability. Nullable.

context_note.description: Optional freeform context/note for this adjustment (such as manual restock batch label, order ID, administrator comment, anomaly fix, etc.). Used for additional traceability. Nullable.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp of when the adjustment was recorded (immutable, set by system at creation).

IShoppingInventoryAlert.IRequest.description:
Advanced query, filtering, and pagination DTO for searching inventory alerts tied to a specific SKU in the shopping_inventory_alerts table. DTO is used exclusively as input for API endpoints retrieving alerts. Required query parameters: page, limit, sort_by, sort_order. All others are optional filters.

Fields:
- alert_type: Filter for one or more business-defined alert type codes ('low_stock', 'out_of_stock', 'anomaly', 'manual'). Null or omitted includes all alert types.
- resolved: True = closed alerts only; false = currently active/open. Null/omitted = both states.
- triggered_at_from/to: Range filter for alert creation time (ISO8601 UTC only).
- resolved_at_from/to: Range filter for alert resolution time (ISO8601 UTC only). Ineffective if unresolved.
- context: Substring/keyword search for operator notes or business context. Null/omitted = no filter.
- page/limit: Required pagination controls; page >=1; limit 1–100 per platform max.
- sort_by: Sort results by trigger or resolution time; allowed values: 'triggered_at', 'resolved_at'.
- sort_order: Sort ascending/descending (oldest/newest-first). Allowed values: 'asc', 'desc'.

Supports audit, real-time incident response, inventory management, and compliance analytics. Returned records are subject to authorization (sellers: own SKUs; admins: global scope). All dates/times must be ISO8601 UTC in both input and results. Aligns with shopping_inventory_alerts schema and inventory management requirements for completeness, precision, and usability in business operations.

oneOf.description: Filter: Only include alerts with matching business alert type. Allowed values: 'low_stock', 'out_of_stock', 'anomaly', 'manual'. Null/omitted includes all.

alert_type.description: Filter: Only include alerts with matching business alert type. Allowed values: 'low_stock', 'out_of_stock', 'anomaly', 'manual'. Null/omitted includes all.

oneOf.description: Filter: true = resolved/closed alerts only; false = only currently open/active alerts; null = both open and resolved alerts.

resolved.description: Filter: true = resolved/closed alerts only; false = only currently open/active alerts; null = both open and resolved alerts.

oneOf.description: Return only alerts triggered at or after this time (ISO8601 UTC). Null/omitted disables filter.

triggered_at_from.description: Return only alerts triggered at or after this time (ISO8601 UTC). Null/omitted disables filter.

oneOf.description: Return only alerts triggered at or before this time (ISO8601 UTC). Null/omitted disables filter.

triggered_at_to.description: Return only alerts triggered at or before this time (ISO8601 UTC). Null/omitted disables filter.

oneOf.description: Return only alerts resolved on/after this time (ISO8601 UTC). Null/omitted disables filter.

resolved_at_from.description: Return only alerts resolved on/after this time (ISO8601 UTC). Null/omitted disables filter.

oneOf.description: Return only alerts resolved on/before this time (ISO8601 UTC). Null/omitted disables filter.

resolved_at_to.description: Return only alerts resolved on/before this time (ISO8601 UTC). Null/omitted disables filter.

oneOf.description: Free-form/keyword search for matching substring in context_note. Use for quick incident or operator trace filtering. Null = not filtered.

context.description: Free-form/keyword search for matching substring in context_note. Use for quick incident or operator trace filtering. Null = not filtered.

page.description: Result page number. First page is 1. REQUIRED for all queries.

limit.description: Max returned results per page; platform max 100. REQUIRED for all requests.

oneOf.description: Sort by alert triggered timestamp.
Sort by alert resolved timestamp.

sort_by.description: Result sort key: 'triggered_at' or 'resolved_at'. REQUIRED.

oneOf.description: Sort direction: ascending (oldest-first).
Sort direction: descending (newest-first).

sort_order.description: Sort direction for result records. Allowed values: 'asc', 'desc'. REQUIRED.

IShoppingInventoryAlert.description: Represents a platform-level inventory alert tied to a single SKU, generated automatically or manually to signal significant inventory lifecycle events. Used for operational, risk management, anomaly detection, or compliance workflows for sellers, admins, and auditors. Each alert instance logs type, status, business trigger, actor resolution context, and high-fidelity audit metadata—enabling root-cause analysis, proactive risk mitigation, and business policy enforcement. Core alert types are business constants: 'low_stock', 'out_of_stock', 'anomaly', 'manual'. Resolution tracks closure, escalation, or remediation action through actor/actor_type fields, supporting audit-compliant traceability. Aligns with shopping_inventory_alerts Prisma model, cross-references business entity and actor ID conventions for platform audit and security consistency.

id.description: Unique identifier for this inventory alert (UUID primary key). Used for audit, cross-reference, and retrieval.

shopping_sku_id.description: UUID of the SKU this alert is about. Foreign key: shopping_skus.id. One alert is always associated to one SKU entity.

alert_type.description: Business code for the operational type of alert. Allowed values: 'low_stock', 'out_of_stock', 'anomaly', 'manual'. Codes match platform inventory control policy and must be referenced as constants by consumers (never free-form). Specify by use-case: 'low_stock' = below configured threshold; 'out_of_stock' = zero remaining; 'anomaly' = detected process, reconciliation or data drift; 'manual' = user/operator-created situation/event. Reference allowed enum values for inventory alert domain in business policy documentation.

resolved.description: Resolution state of the alert: true = closed/resolved (addressed or dismissed); false = still open/active. Alerts remain open until explicitly resolved by a business action or process. All closed alerts retain full audit and event history.

triggered_at.description: Timestamp (ISO8601 UTC) when this alert was created/triggered. Used for sequencing, analysis, and filtering. Timezone must be UTC only.

oneOf.description: UTC datetime when this alert was marked as resolved/closed. Null if alert is still open/active.

resolved_at.description: UTC datetime when this alert was marked as resolved/closed. Null if alert is still open/active.

oneOf.description: Actor role/class that resolved/closed the alert: 'admin', 'seller', or 'system'. Must match platform actor domain enum. Null if unresolved.

resolved_actor_type.description: Actor role/class that resolved/closed the alert: 'admin', 'seller', or 'system'. Must match platform actor domain enum. Null if unresolved.

oneOf.description: UUID of actor who performed resolution (referencing admins/sellers/system ID). Null if unresolved.

resolved_actor_id.description: UUID of actor who performed resolution (referencing admins/sellers/system ID). Null if unresolved.

oneOf.description: Optional free-form business context or operator note documenting the trigger reason, remediation, or root-cause. May include incident reference, step-by-step resolution, or mitigation instructions. Null if no note recorded.

context_note.description: Optional free-form business context or operator note documenting the trigger reason, remediation, or root-cause. May include incident reference, step-by-step resolution, or mitigation instructions. Null if no note recorded.

IShoppingCart.IRequest.description: Filter and pagination information for shopping cart list retrieval. Includes page, limit, customer, date filtering, and sort controls. Does not include any sensitive customer data.

page.description: Pagination: which result page to fetch. Default: 1 (first page).

limit.description: Pagination: number of carts per page. Business-default 20, maximum 100.

shopping_customer_id.description: Filter by owning customer's unique UUID (FK to shopping_customers.id). Supply to search carts by customer.

created_from.description: Filter: carts created at or after this UTC ISO datetime.

created_to.description: Filter: carts created at or before this UTC ISO datetime.

updated_from.description: Filter: carts updated at or after this UTC ISO datetime (activity-based search).

updated_to.description: Filter: carts updated at or before this UTC ISO datetime.

oneOf.description: Column to use for sorting results (creation or last update timestamp).
Column to use for sorting results (creation or last update timestamp).

sort_by.description: Column to use for sorting results (creation or last update timestamp).

Sort order: ascending or descending by the chosen sort_by column.

IShoppingCart.description: Represents the detailed state and contents of a shopping cart in the shopping mall platform. Used to communicate the entire cart context including customer linkage, items, and timestamps for administrative viewing or order review. This model is directly mapped to the shopping_carts table and includes strong relations to customer and cart items as well as composition and reference objects for SKUs. All properties, relations, and timestamps are included for full context and audit traceability. Fulfills the return of /shopping/admin/carts/{cartId} and customer-facing self-cart endpoints. Related to IShoppingCartItem and IShoppingCustomer.ISummary.

id.description: Unique identifier for this cart (UUID). Sourced from shopping_carts.id.

customer.description: Customer context for this cart. Transformed from shopping_customers and uses .ISummary to avoid circular references.

items.description: All shopping cart item records for this cart (shopping_cart_items), each representing a unique SKU, quantity, and item-level context.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the cart was created (shopping_carts.created_at).

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update to the cart or its items (shopping_carts.updated_at).

IShoppingCart.IUpdate.description: Request structure for atomically replacing all items within a given shopping cart. Used for customer self-management or admin-level modification of cart contents. All specified items will become the new state of the cart, replacing any pre-existing items not included in the request. This means all items not present in the 'items' array will be removed from the cart, ensuring a complete replacement (no partial merge). This DTO validates every included item for SKU existence, inventory business limits, and ownership prior to applying any changes. All requirements for validation, inventory, ownership, and replacement are enforced as per the shopping_carts and shopping_cart_items Prisma schema definitions. Only the owning customer or authorized admin can perform this update. Clients must send the complete desired cart content in 'items', and omitted SKUs are removed from the cart.

items.description: Complete replacement list of cart items for the target cart. Each entry is validated against the IShoppingCartItem.IUpdate schema and must correspond to an intended SKU and quantity. All current cart items not present in this array will be removed from the cart, ensuring atomic replacement (not merge). Every item in this array must satisfy SKU existence, business rule, and inventory constraints. Array of IShoppingCartItem.IUpdate (see schema for format and validation).

id.description: Unique identifier for the cart item. This corresponds to the primary key (id) of the shopping_cart_items table in the database.

shopping_cart_id.description: Identifier (UUID) of the cart to which this item belongs. References shopping_carts.id for relation and API context. Used for audit and traceability.

sku.description: SKU referenced by this cart item, provided as a summary reference object for fast display and business logic validation. The summary includes the code, price, and relevant details for frontend/cart decision making (not only the SKU code). Sourced from shopping_skus and used for display, order previews, and validation.

quantity.description: Number of units for this SKU in the cart. Enforced by business maximum per-SKU policy and real-time inventory validation; must always be at least 1. Maximum is determined by platform rules configured in shopping_business_constraints.

added_at.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601 format) when the item was first added to the cart. Populated from shopping_cart_items.added_at. Used for sorting and audit.

updated_at.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601 format) when the cart item was last updated (quantity/sku change). Populated from shopping_cart_items.updated_at. Used for cache/business invalidation and UX.

cart_owner.description: Summary information of the cart owner (customer), provided for context and display. This is derived from the customer relation referenced in shopping_carts.customer, which points to shopping_customers. Used for ownership validation and audit trail.

error_flags.description: Any error, warning, or business rule violation flags for this cart item. Typical values include: 'sku_inactive', 'insufficient_stock', 'sku_archived', 'max_quantity_exceeded'. These flags indicate current validation or state issues with this cart item and are intended to be checked by the frontend/client to display warnings or block checkout as appropriate. The array may be empty if no errors. Returned only at cart fetch and item detail endpoints.

IShoppingCartItem.description: Complete representation of a cart item in shopping_cart_items, mapped directly to the shopping_cart_items Prisma table. Includes cart relationship identification, SKU summary object, quantity, audit timestamps, resolved customer summary for the cart owner, and a list of current error or business-rule violation flags for robust frontend handling. No user/actor IDs needed in the request body; all relations are context-supplied and/or read-only. This type is used in get/update cart item APIs and for final cart display (checkout/review).

quantity.description: The desired quantity for this SKU in the cart after update. If set to zero, the cart item will be removed. Must respect catalog max/min and available inventory.

IShoppingCartItem.IUpdate.description: Request DTO for updating the quantity of a cart item within a customer's shopping cart. Directly maps to the shopping_cart_items schema. Only the quantity field may be modified, all others are system-managed or derived from relations. Setting quantity to zero triggers deletion/removal of the cart item. Used by PUT /shopping/customer/carts/{cartId}/items/{itemId} operation.

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting from 1. Used for paginated retrieval of cart items.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page in paginated results. Enforced by business constraint (e.g., 20-100).

sku_code.description: SKU code to filter cart items. Only items matching this SKU will be returned.

min_quantity.description: Filter: minimum quantity of cart items to include.

max_quantity.description: Filter: maximum quantity of cart items to include.

sort_by.description: Sort key for items (e.g., 'added_at', 'quantity', 'sku_code'). Must match allowed sortable fields.

oneOf.description: Sort direction: ascending or descending. Allowed values are 'asc' (ascending) and 'desc' (descending).
Sort direction: ascending or descending. Allowed values are 'asc' (ascending) and 'desc' (descending).

order.description: Sort direction: ascending or descending. Allowed values are 'asc' (ascending) and 'desc' (descending).

IShoppingCartItem.IRequest.description: Parameters for searching, filtering, sorting, and paginating cart items in a customer's shopping cart. Used to retrieve a subset of cart items from shopping_cart_items table by various criteria. No actor/customer_id fields as context is provided by authentication and parent cart path.

shopping_sku_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the SKU to add to the cart. Must reference a valid, active entry in the shopping_skus table.

quantity.description: The number of units for this SKU requested to be added to the cart. Must be a positive integer and is limited by stock availability and platform policy (e.g., max 10 per SKU).

IShoppingCartItem.ICreate.description: Request DTO for adding a product SKU to a customer's shopping cart. Maps directly to the shopping_cart_items table except for the cart/account context (provided by authentication and the enclosing endpoint path). Excludes all server-managed fields (id, added_at, updated_at), and cart/actor references which are provided from path or JWT context.

id.description: The unique identifier of the guest cart (UUID). Primary key of shopping_guest_carts.

session_key.description: Opaque session key identifying the guest cart (typically UUID, possibly random secret). Used for reference and merging operations.

created_at.description: Cart creation timestamp (ISO8601 date/time string).

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the cart was last modified (ISO8601).

expires_at.description: Timestamp when the cart will expire and be subject to automatic deletion (ISO8601). Set according to guest cart retention policy.

items.description: Array of items currently in the guest cart. Each item includes SKU reference, quantity, and item timestamps. Fetched from shopping_guest_cart_items.

IShoppingGuestCartItem.description: Represents a guest (session-based, unauthenticated) shopping cart with metadata and item list. Does not include customer/account linkage. Used for guest cart API responses. All fields are readonly except items, which can be changed via update/merge endpoints. Related tables: shopping_guest_carts (for metadata such as timestamps) and shopping_guest_cart_items (for item details).

items.description: The complete, new list of guest cart items (SKU IDs and quantities) to set for the guest cart. This array replaces the current cart items entirely. Quantity, stock, and SKU validity will be enforced by business logic.

IShoppingGuestCartItem.IUpdate.description: DTO for updating (fully replacing, atomically) all items in a guest (session-based) shopping cart. Called by the /shopping/guestCarts/{guestCartId} PUT endpoint, this operation sets the entire list of items for the cart in one atomic step—overwriting all prior items. Each item must reference a valid SKU in the catalog: quantities must be strictly positive (zero quantity is NOT permitted—use DELETE on /items/{itemId} to remove instead). The API also enforces maximum-quantity-per-SKU and will reject the request if any item exceeds business limits or references an invalid SKU. Stock checks and all business logic constraints are validated before update. This DTO is not used for account-based carts and contains no sensitive/customer identity fields. Related Prisma table: shopping_guest_cart_items.

IShoppingGuestCartItem.ISummary.description: Summary DTO for a guest user's shopping cart. Contains the unique session key and a list of cart items, optimized for display and merging upon login/registration. Does not include sensitive internal cart metadata or customer associations.

session_key.description: Opaque session key uniquely identifying the guest cart in application logic.

created_at.description: When the guest cart was created.

updated_at.description: When the guest cart was last updated.

expires_at.description: Expiration timestamp for the guest cart.

items.description: List of items currently contained in the guest's cart.

IShoppingGuestCartItem.ICreate.description:
Request body schema for adding a new item (SKU) to a guest user's shopping cart session. Corresponds directly to the required insertion columns for the 'shopping_guest_cart_items' database table, minus all system-managed identifiers. Used only in unauthenticated (guest) user flows prior to registration or login.

This DTO must specify the unique identifier of the SKU to be added (shopping_sku_id) and the desired quantity to add to the guest cart. Fields representing system identifiers, timestamps, or relational context are omitted since they are managed internally by the backend. All required fields reflect strict validation per the underlying Prisma schema.

Refer to 'shopping_guest_cart_items' for property requirements and ERD relationships. Business and inventory rules (e.g., SKU existence, stock validation, quantity restrictions) are enforced by the backend during API processing.

shopping_sku_id.description: Foreign key ID referencing the SKU (shopping_skus.id) to add to the guest cart. This is mandatory and must reference a valid, active SKU.

quantity.description: Desired number of units for the selected SKU to add to the guest cart. Business logic enforces that this is a positive integer and may additionally restrict maximums per SKU per cart.

page.description: The page number for pagination (defaults to 1 if omitted).

limit.description: Maximum number of items per page for wishlist list results. Platform default is 20 and maximum allowed is 100.

search.description: Optional keyword to search by product name, brand, or SKU within the user's wishlist items.

tag_codes.description: List of tag codes to filter wishlist items by user-specified tags. Only items with at least one matching tag will be included.

category_codes.description: List of category codes to filter wishlist items for associated product categories. Only wishlist items whose products belong to the provided categories will be listed.

in_stock_only.description: Filter flag: if true, includes only wishlist items with currently available/in-stock SKUs.

oneOf.description: Sort order for the wishlist items. Supported values: 'recent' (default, most recently updated first), 'oldest', 'name', 'price_asc', 'price_desc'.
Sort order for the wishlist items. Supported values: 'recent' (default, most recently updated first), 'oldest', 'name', 'price_asc', 'price_desc'.
Sort order for the wishlist items. Supported values: 'recent' (default, most recently updated first), 'oldest', 'name', 'price_asc', 'price_desc'.
Sort order for the wishlist items. Supported values: 'recent' (default, most recently updated first), 'oldest', 'name', 'price_asc', 'price_desc'.
Sort order for the wishlist items. Supported values: 'recent' (default, most recently updated first), 'oldest', 'name', 'price_asc', 'price_desc'.

sort_by.description: Sort order for the wishlist items. Supported values: 'recent' (default, most recently updated first), 'oldest', 'name', 'price_asc', 'price_desc'.

IShoppingWishlist.IRequest.description:
DTO for wishlist item retrieval options (search/filter/query params).
Includes pagination, search, tag/category filters, stock-only filtering, and sort order. Used as the request body or query parameter bag for wishlist list endpoints. The request is always scoped to the authenticated customer account. Defaults: page=1, limit=20, sort_by=recent.

id.description: Unique identifier for this wishlist. Corresponds to the primary key in the shopping_wishlists table.

shopping_customer_id.description: Identifier of the customer who owns this wishlist. This is a foreign key to shopping_customers.id, but is only used internally and not shown in UI responses.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the wishlist was created. Sourced from shopping_wishlists.created_at.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent update (item add/remove, rename, etc.), from shopping_wishlists.updated_at.

items.description: Current array of items (SKUs) included in this wishlist. Each includes SKU/product summary for UI display.

IShoppingWishlist.description: Represents a customer-owned wishlist, as defined in the shopping_wishlists table. Contains metadata and the full list of SKU items currently in the wishlist. This object is used as the primary response for fetching and updating customer wishlists, including all related SKU/product references. Deleted_at is used for soft-delete logic and auditing.

IShoppingWishlistItem.description:
Represents a single item in a customer's wishlist. Maps to the shopping_wishlist_items table and joins to the related SKU entity for catalog details.

Each wishlist item corresponds to a unique SKU that the customer wishes to save. Ownership is enforced by linkage to the parent wishlist/customer rather than request body fields. This object is returned by item querying, creation, and update responses.

Business logic ensures that for a given wishlist there can be no duplicate entries for the same SKU. This type must embed or reference the associated SKU for enriched display (e.g., product name, price, image) via $ref relations. It includes the SKU reference, addition timestamp, and all relevant metadata. Contains no actor fields; permission scope is enforced server-side.

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the wishlist item. Maps to shopping_wishlist_items.id.

sku.description: Summary information about the saved SKU, including catalog details. $ref: IShoppingSKU.ISummary

added_at.description: Timestamp when this wishlist item was added (ISO 8601 format). Maps to shopping_wishlist_items.added_at.

note.description: Optional customer note for the wishlist item. For personalization. Not required.

updated_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the wishlist was last updated, in ISO 8601 UTC format (e.g., '2025-10-31T14:37:52.391Z'). Used by the platform for concurrency, mutation audit, and historical trace in wishlist update operations. Business logic mandates UTC for all audit and transactional timestamps.

IShoppingWishlist.IUpdate.description: Schema for updating the last modified date/time of a wishlist in the shopping mall platform. Used exclusively in authenticated mutation operations to ensure audit-compliant update timestamping, concurrency protection, and transactional integrity. Ownership and context are always inferred via authentication; this operation never accepts actor/ownership fields in the request. This DTO should not be used for wishlist creation or ownership transfer flows.

IShoppingWishlistItem.IRequest.description: Query parameter schema for retrieving wishlist items for a specific wishlist. Used in the 'index' operation to support advanced filtering, search, and pagination of wishlist contents for a customer. Includes paging, search, filter criteria, and is designed for safe, scoped retrieval to the authenticated user's own wishlist. No direct actor identity fields; the system securely derives scope from the authenticated JWT. All fields are optional except pagination defaults. This schema references the 'shopping_wishlist_items' and 'shopping_wishlists' tables for implementation. Read-only; not mapped to any specific Prisma model directly.

page.description: Request page number for pagination (1-based). Defaults to 1 if omitted.

limit.description: Page size: maximum number of wishlist items to return per page. Default 20, maximum 100.

search.description: Full-text search query (applies to product name, SKU code, etc.). Optional—matches across all associated catalog data.

oneOf.description: Field to sort by. Supports: 'added_at' (default, newest first), 'sku_code', 'product_name'.
Field to sort by. Supports: 'added_at' (default, newest first), 'sku_code', 'product_name'.
Field to sort by. Supports: 'added_at' (default, newest first), 'sku_code', 'product_name'.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by. Supports: 'added_at' (default, newest first), 'sku_code', 'product_name'.

oneOf.description: Sort direction: 'asc' = ascending, 'desc' = descending order. Default is 'desc'.
Sort direction: 'asc' = ascending, 'desc' = descending order. Default is 'desc'.

sort_direction.description: Sort direction: 'asc' = ascending, 'desc' = descending order. Default is 'desc'.

sku_code.description: Globally unique code identifying the SKU to be added to the wishlist. Must correspond to an existing SKU in the catalog. The code is validated against the shopping_skus table for existence and uniqueness.

IShoppingWishlistItem.ICreate.description: Request DTO for adding a SKU to a customer's wishlist. This object is used as the request body when a customer adds an item to their wishlist. Only the sku_code is accepted; wishlist ownership is enforced by the path parameter context and cannot be overridden in the request body. No authentication or system-generated fields are included in this DTO.

note.description: Optional user note or comment attached to the wishlist item. Allows customers to add personal annotations, reminders, or contextual comments. Maximum 255 characters. If set to an empty string or omitted, any existing note is cleared or left unchanged, respectively. This field is optional for partial updates.

IShoppingWishlistItem.IUpdate.description: Request DTO for updating a wishlist item. This object allows updating user-controlled metadata fields only. Currently, the only updatable field is `note`, which lets users attach or update a comment for the wishlist item (up to 255 characters). All other key fields (such as SKU reference) remain immutable after creation. No system-managed or identity fields may be updated. This DTO will be future extensible as additional user metadata fields become supported.

IShoppingOrder.IRequest.description:
Request schema for searching and paginating shopping orders for an authenticated customer. This DTO is used as the body for order history/filter endpoints supporting advanced querying, pagination, search, and sorting. It allows customers to filter their order history by status, order_code, product name, date ranges, and more. Business logic ensures results are limited to only the requesting customer's own orders. This schema does not include system-managed or authentication fields – only client-provided filter and control properties. Does NOT contain direct customer_id and is compatible with the atomic order history read operation pattern.

Fields:
- search: Free-text search for order code/product name
- status: Filter orders by business status (such as pending, completed, canceled)
- from_date/to_date: Filter by order creation timestamps (ISO 8601 format, UTC)
- sort_by: Which field to sort on (e.g., 'created_at', 'total_price')
- sort_order: Ascending/descending sort order
- page: 1-based current results page
- limit: Max results per page (business-restricted to 20-100 or as configured)

search.description: Optional free-text search parameter. Matches order_code or product name for orders belonging to the current customer. Used for searching order history by reference, name, or item.

status.description: Optional order status filter (e.g., 'pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'completed', 'cancelled'). Applies to the status field in shopping_orders.

from_date.description: Optional filter for results with orders created_at after or on this UTC ISO8601 timestamp.

to_date.description: Optional filter for results with orders created_at before or on this UTC ISO8601 timestamp.

oneOf.description: Optional sort key. Allowed values: created_at (default), total_price, status.
Optional sort key. Allowed values: created_at (default), total_price, status.
Optional sort key. Allowed values: created_at (default), total_price, status.

sort_by.description: Optional sort key. Allowed values: created_at (default), total_price, status.

oneOf.description: Sort direction for sort_by field. 'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending. Default: 'desc'.
Sort direction for sort_by field. 'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending. Default: 'desc'.

sort_order.description: Sort direction for sort_by field. 'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending. Default: 'desc'.

page.description: 1-based page number for paginated results. Default: 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of results per page. Recommended default: 20; hard max: 100.

IShoppingOrder.description:
Represents the complete detailed order view including all related entities according to the shopping_orders schema.
Returned from detail endpoints for customer, seller, and admin (GET /shopping/(customer|seller|admin)/orders/{orderCode}). This type contains the order's core data, order lines (items), per-seller splits, all addresses, order status transitions, payment attempts, fulfillment status, and shipment. Carefully maps all business and audit context, and is security-filtered to model the recipient's permissions.

All relations that are atomic to the order lifecycle are included as nested objects/arrays. Foreign keys to sellers, customers, and products are represented as Summary objects or IDs as per platform FK handling guidelines.

id.description: Unique order identifier (UUID PK). Corresponds to shopping_orders.id.

order_code.description: Globally unique business order reference code for the order (e.g., ORD-20240001). Maps to shopping_orders.order_code.

total_price.description: Total price of the order (sum of all line items). Matches shopping_orders.total_price.

status.description: Current business status of the order (see status history for transitions). E.g. 'pending', 'paid', 'processing', 'fulfilled', 'cancelled'.

created_at.description: Order creation timestamp in UTC (ISO8601). Pulled from shopping_orders.created_at.

updated_at.description: Last modification timestamp for this order in UTC (ISO8601).

oneOf.description: If populated, this order is soft-deleted/archived (compliance & audit).

deleted_at.description: If populated, this order is soft-deleted/archived (compliance & audit).

customer.description: Summary information for the customer who placed this order. Transforms shopping_customer_id FK according to summary rules.

order_lines.description: All constituent line items for this order. Each line represents a purchased SKU (quantity, price, fulfillment status, etc). Ordered as placed in the cart or by fulfillment importance.

order_splits.description: Per-seller breakdown of the order. Each split isolates items and total for one seller, mirroring multi-seller checkout business rules.

addresses.description: Complete set of delivery and billing address records used for this order (see shopping_order_addresses).

status_history.description: Complete audit history of status transitions, fulfilling business trace and compliance requirements.

payment_attempts.description: All payment attempts associated with this order (success/failure/cancelled) for audit and processing tracking.

shipments.description: All shipments related to the order, mapping to the shopping_shipments table and associated logistics state.

id.description: Unique identifier for this order line in shopping_order_lines (UUID, PK).

sku.description: SKU associated with this order line (joins via shopping_sku_id).

quantity.description: Quantity of this SKU ordered in this line item. Non-nullable. Enforced by Prisma Int. Sourced from shopping_order_lines.quantity.

status.description: Current status of this order line (e.g., pending, shipped, delivered, canceled, refunded). Sourced from status field. Follows the business state as defined by platform enums.

seller.description: Seller responsible for fulfilling this order line (joins shopping_seller_id).

fulfillments.description: Fulfillment records linked to this order line, listing shipment or packing actions (see shopping_order_fulfillments).

created_at.description: When this order line was created (from shopping_order_lines.created_at).

updated_at.description: When this order line was last updated (from shopping_order_lines.updated_at).

oneOf.description: Soft-delete marker. If not null, this order line has been archived or removed from normal business flow for audit/compliance (from shopping_order_lines.deleted_at; lines with this populated are typically hidden from standard operational queries).

deleted_at.description: Soft-delete marker. If not null, this order line has been archived or removed from normal business flow for audit/compliance (from shopping_order_lines.deleted_at; lines with this populated are typically hidden from standard operational queries).

IShoppingOrderLine.description: Detailed information for a single order line item, as defined in shopping_order_lines. Includes references to SKU (sku), responsible seller (seller), quantities, pricing, fulfillment status, timestamps, and soft deletion state. 'deleted_at' indicates audit/archive state (soft deletion). Fulfills requirements for order detail/fulfillment APIs.

id.description: Unique split ID for this order split (shopping_order_splits.id, PK).

split_code.description: Business reference code for this split (shopping_order_splits.split_code). In combination with 'order_id', forms a composite unique business key for identifying splits within an order.

subtotal_price.description: Subtotal price for this seller split in the order (shopping_order_splits.subtotal_price; Float, non-nullable).

status.description: Current business status of the split (shopping_order_splits.status), e.g. 'pending', 'fulfilled', 'cancelled', per status enum/business workflow.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp for this order split (shopping_order_splits.created_at).

updated_at.description: Timestamp for last update (shopping_order_splits.updated_at).

order_id.description: Unique identifier for the parent order (shopping_orders.id). Foreign key; used for reference and composite split lookup.

seller.description: Summary object for the seller responsible for this split. Transformed from shopping_seller_id reference; matches IShoppingSeller.ISummary.

order_status_histories.description: Array of status change audit trail records for this split. Tracks fulfillment and business workflow progress.

IShoppingOrderSplit.description: DTO for order split entity (shopping_order_splits table). Used to represent the sub-order allocated to a seller in a multi-seller order. 'order_id' is the reference to the parent order (shopping_orders.id). 'split_code' and 'order_id' together uniquely identify this split. Fields include seller summary, subtotal, status, and audit trail status histories (order_status_histories array).

IShoppingOrderAddress.description:
Order address entity representing a shipping or billing address associated with a specific customer order. Used to store delivery and billing location details for fulfillment, compliance, and audit. Contains address fields required for shipment processing, recipient identification, and legal documentation. Follows the structure defined in the shopping_order_addresses table of the Prisma schema.

This object includes all address information as it existed at the time of order and supports international formats. It is referenced by APIs that retrieve shipping/billing address details for a given order, displaying confirmation during shipment, and supporting audit-trail workflows for customer, seller, and admin users. Only accessible to authorized actors according to the requirements and endpoints described in the business logic documentation.

id.description: Unique identifier of the order address record. References PK of shopping_order_addresses.

shopping_order_id.description: Identifier of the order this address belongs to. References shopping_orders.id.

type.description: Type of address record for the order (e.g., 'shipping', 'billing'), as recorded per API and front-end conventions.

recipient_name.description: Full recipient name for the address, to be displayed on shipping/billing labels and for delivery confirmation.

recipient_phone.description: Phone number of the recipient for contact and delivery notification. Follows local formatting rules.

zip_code.description: Postal or ZIP code for the address, as formatted by destination country or region.

base_address.description: Primary line of the street address (not including apartment or other details), used for shipment routing.

detail_address.description: Supplementary details (apartment, suite, building, etc) for delivery targeting. May be null or omitted if not needed, and is not mandatory for every address.

city.description: City or locality for this address, as required for carrier and regulatory compliance.

state_province.description: State, province, or administrative region for this address. Necessary for certain delivery and tax documentation.

country.description: Country identifier for this address, typically ISO 3166-1 country name.

created_at.description: Timestamp recording when the address record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp noting the last update to the address record.

IShoppingOrderStatusHistory.description: Represents a transition in the status history of a shopping order, as defined in shopping_order_status_histories.

id.description: Primary key of the status history entry. Matches the 'id' field in shopping_order_status_histories. Serves as a unique identifier for audit and retrieval.

shopping_order_id.description: ID of the order this status history entry belongs to. Maps to 'shopping_order_id' in Prisma.

shopping_order_split_id.description: Optional ID of the specific order split (by seller) to which this status applies; null if the status was changed for the parent order. Maps to 'shopping_order_split_id' in Prisma.

from_status.description: Order status before this transition. E.g., 'pending', 'paid', 'processing'. Reflects business logic values stored in 'from_status'.

to_status.description: Order status after the transition. E.g., 'paid', 'fulfilled', 'cancelled'. Maps to 'to_status' in Prisma.

triggered_by.description: The actor or system component that initiated the status change. E.g., 'system', 'customer', 'seller', or 'admin'. Provides traceability of business events ('triggered_by' in Prisma).

event_note.description: Optional freeform context, reason, or comments relating to this status event. Maps to 'event_note' in Prisma; may provide details helpful for audit or support.

occurred_at.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601, UTC) when this transition event happened. Derived from 'occurred_at' in shopping_order_status_histories. Used for constructing order tracking timelines.

IShoppingOrderPaymentAttempt.description:
Payment attempt record for an order. Each record logs gateway, status, reference, timestamps, and other audit info. Essential for full payment tracking, fraud prevention, and business analysis. One per attempt, multiple if retries/failures.

Fields:
- id: Unique identifier
- payment_reference: Provider or gateway reference
- attempt_status: Payment status ('pending', 'completed', 'failed', etc)
- amount: Amount attempted to charge
- attempted_at: Attempt start
- completed_at: End (nullable)

id.description: Primary key for the payment attempt record.

payment_reference.description: External payment provider gateway reference (optional, may be empty until submitted).

oneOf.description: Status for this attempt (pending, completed, failed, cancelled).
Status for this attempt (pending, completed, failed, cancelled).
Status for this attempt (pending, completed, failed, cancelled).
Status for this attempt (pending, completed, failed, cancelled).

attempt_status.description: Status for this attempt (pending, completed, failed, cancelled).

amount.description: Total amount attempted to charge in this payment event.

completed_at.description: When payment attempt finished (success/failure), nullable if still pending.

IShoppingOrderShipment.description:
Represents a logical shipment (possibly split shipment) for an order. Summarizes high-level delivery status, carrier info, times, and identifies the seller responsible for each package logistics. Derived from shopping_shipments table.

Fields:
- id: Shipment unique identifier (UUID)
- seller: Seller responsible for this shipment
- code: Shipment reference code
- status: Business status (pending, packed, in_transit, delivered, cancelled, returned)
- carrier_company: Name of shipper/courier (FedEx, CJ대한통운, etc)
- scheduled_dispatch_at: Planned warehouse dispatch
- dispatched_at: Actual shipment date
- delivered_at: Courier-delivered timestamp
- canceled_at: If shipment canceled
- created_at, updated_at

id.description: Shipment record ID (UUID PK).

seller.description: Seller responsible for this shipment (context for logistics ownership).

code.description: Unique business reference code for the shipment (e.g., SHPT-xxx).

status.description: Shipment business status. Valid values include: pending, packed, in_transit, delivered, cancelled, returned, per shopping_shipments.status.

carrier_company.description: Display name of the carrier/courier accepting the shipment.

dispatched_at.description: Time shipper/courier picked up and activated shipping, nullable.

canceled_at.description: If shipment was cancelled, timestamp is populated, else null.

created_at.description: Entity creation timestamp.

updated_at.description: Entity last update timestamp (audit/compliance)

IShoppingOrder.ICreate.description: Request DTO to create a new order. Contains business-validated summary of cart items, delivery and billing addresses, selected payment method, and optionally a coupon code. The actor/customer is NOT included—actor will be derived from authentication context. All mapping is to shopping_orders and related entities. SECURITY: customer_id is never received from the client.

total_price.description: Total price for the entire order, as aggregated from requested items. Maps to: shopping_orders.total_price. The backend will validate correctness according to business rules.

order_lines.description: All order line items within this order. Each line represents a unique SKU being purchased, quantity, and calculated price. Will be inserted as shopping_order_lines. Minimum 1 item.

shipping_addresses.description: List of addresses provided at checkout for the order. At least one must be type 'shipping'; optionally, one can be 'billing.' These will populate shopping_order_addresses.

payment_method.description: Selected payment method identifier or code by the customer for paying the order. Must be a valid active payment option for this customer.

oneOf.description: Optional coupon or promotional code for discounts. Validation handled by business service.

coupon_code.description: Optional coupon or promotional code for discounts. Validation handled by business service.

shopping_sku_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) to be ordered. This must reference a valid SKU in the catalog, representing a specific variant (e.g., size, color) of a product. Required for linking the order line to the inventory and pricing context.

quantity.description: The number of units of the specified SKU to be included in this order line. Must be at least 1. The quantity must not exceed available stock. Business logic enforces per-SKU/order/customer limits as per platform configuration.

unit_price.description: The final per-unit price to be recorded for this SKU in the order. This is post-discount (if any) and represents the amount to be paid per item for this order line. This must match the latest valid price at cart/order finalization.

IShoppingOrderLine.ICreate.description: DTO for creating a new order line under a customer order (shopping_order_lines). This schema is used during pre-checkout or admin order edits to append a new SKU, specifying quantity and definitive per-unit price. Parent order reference is implied by path parameter and must NOT be included in the request body. Business logic validates order/edit state, SKU/stock correctness, and prevents addition to finalized, deleted, or paid orders. See shopping_order_lines table for DB schema.

IShoppingOrderAddress.ICreate.description: Input schema for delivery/billing address at order creation (shopping_order_addresses). All required fields correspond to the table columns except for system fields.

oneOf.description: The address type for this record. Allowed values: 'shipping' or 'billing'. Maps to shopping_order_addresses.type.
The address type for this record. Allowed values: 'shipping' or 'billing'. Maps to shopping_order_addresses.type.

type.description: The address type for this record. Allowed values: 'shipping' or 'billing'. Maps to shopping_order_addresses.type.

recipient_name.description: The name of the delivery or billing recipient. E.g. full customer name.

recipient_phone.description: The phone number for the recipient. Must be valid for delivery contact.

zip_code.description: Postal or ZIP code for the address, per destination country.

oneOf.description: Apartment, floor, suite, etc. Additional details.

detail_address.description: Apartment, floor, suite, etc. Additional details.

city.description: City or district for the address.

state_province.description: State or province/region for the address.

country.description: Country code or name (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or platform normalized).

IShoppingOrder.IUpdate.description: Update DTO for modifying certain fields of an order (e.g. status or address update) by authorized business actors. Does NOT allow mod of immutable fields like order_code, customer, or pricing. All fields optional. Undefined fields are not changed.

status.description: Permissible new status to set for the order. E.g., 'pending', 'paid', 'processing', 'fulfilled', 'canceled', 'refunded', 'completed'. Consult shopping_status_enums for valid values. Only set if changing status.

shipping_addresses.description: Optional: update delivery or billing addresses for the order. Only modifiable before fulfillment/lock.

IShoppingOrderAddress.IUpdate.description: Update DTO for modifying details of an existing order address record (shopping_order_addresses). All fields optional. Undefined fields are not changed. Only permissible prior to fulfillment lock.

oneOf.description: The address type for this record. Allowed values: 'shipping' or 'billing'.
The address type for this record. Allowed values: 'shipping' or 'billing'.

type.description: The address type for this record. Allowed values: 'shipping' or 'billing'.

recipient_name.description: The name of the delivery or billing recipient. Optional update.

oneOf.description: Apartment, floor, suite, etc. Additional details.

detail_address.description: Apartment, floor, suite, etc. Additional details.

page.description: Page number for paginated results (default: 1).

limit.description: Number of order lines per page (default: 20, max: 100).

oneOf.description: Field to sort by: unit_price, status, or created_at.
Field to sort by: unit_price, status, or created_at.
Field to sort by: unit_price, status, or created_at.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by: unit_price, status, or created_at.

oneOf.description: Sort order: asc for ascending, desc for descending.
Sort order: asc for ascending, desc for descending.

sort_order.description: Sort order: asc for ascending, desc for descending.

status.description: Filter by order line status.

fulfillment_status.description: Filter by fulfillment status; matches the status field in fulfillment records.

created_from.description: Filter for lines created at or after this ISO timestamp.

created_to.description: Filter for lines created at or before this ISO timestamp.

IShoppingOrderLine.IRequest.description: Query parameters for retrieving and searching order line items for a specific order. Supports pagination, sorting, status, SKU, seller, fulfillment, and creation date filters. See shopping_order_lines and business requirements.

shopping_sku_id.description: (Optional) If permitted by business rules, the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) for this line can be changed before order finalization. Changing SKU will trigger validation of stock, active status, and duplicate-check in the parent order. May be omitted if SKU not being changed.

quantity.description: (Optional) The new desired quantity for the order line. Must be at least 1 and cannot exceed available stock at edit time. Platform business rules also enforce SKU/customer/order-specific limits. Omit if not changing quantity.

unit_price.description: (Optional) The new per-unit price for the order line. Use this to override or adjust the price before order is finalized. Omit if no price adjustment is being made.

IShoppingOrderLine.IUpdate.description: DTO for updating an existing order line (shopping_order_lines) on an open customer order. Allows edits only before payment/finalization. All properties are optional; any or all may be updated in a single call. Changing SKU is only allowed if permitted by business rules (no existing dependent/locked state). Quantity/price must pass stock, pricing, and business validation. Parent order and order line context are provided in the path, not body. See shopping_order_lines table for DB schema.

seller_id.description: Optional filter: Return only splits belonging to the specified seller. Must be a UUID referencing shopping_sellers.id.

status.description: Optional filter: Return only splits with this status. Values correspond to shopping_order_splits.status. Common statuses include 'pending', 'fulfilled', 'cancelled', 'in_progress', etc.

created_to.description: Optional filter: Only include splits created at or before this timestamp (ISO 8601).

IShoppingOrderSplit.IRequest.description: DTO for searching order splits under a parent order. Allows filtering by seller, split status, creation time, and supports sorting & pagination. Used for admin and dashboard queries referencing the shopping_order_splits table.

shopping_seller_id.description: ID of the seller responsible for fulfilling this split of the order.

updated_at.description: Timestamp for most recent split update.

IShoppingOrderSplit.ISummary.description:
Order Split Summary DTO. Provides a summary representation of a seller-specific split of a customer's order. Used in lists or embedded context to track fulfillment and status per seller for multi-seller orders. Maps directly to the 'shopping_order_splits' table.

Order splits are created when an order contains products from multiple sellers; each split enables independent fulfillment, tracking, and status updates pertinent to a given seller.

id.description: Audit history entry ID (shopping_order_status_histories.id).

triggered_by.description: Role or actor class that initiated this change (customer/seller/admin/system).

IShoppingOrderStatusHistory.ISummary.description: Summary of a single status change event for a split order (used in audits, timelines).

status.description: Mutable status for this seller's split portion of the order (e.g., 'pending', 'fulfilled', 'in_transit', etc). Statuses must conform to allowed states defined in business logic and platform enums.

IShoppingOrderSplit.IUpdate.description: Update DTO for ShoppingOrderSplit. This type is used by sellers/admins to update their portion's split status or similar mutable business fields. Only status is updatable via the admin/seller API – split_code and order_code are path parameters, all identity and ownership fields are system-managed and NOT part of the request body. See shopping_order_splits Prisma schema for details on possible mutable fields. This DTO ensures split integrity, enforces business rules on transitions, and explicitly excludes actor, order ID, and immutable/deleted fields.

to_status.description: Filter for history events where the new status equals this value. Optional. Use values from status enums for 'order' as defined in shopping_status_enums.

actor.description: Filter for a specific triggering actor's identifier (admin/seller/customer/etc). May be an ID, email, or human-readable display name as stored in the event. For detailed polymorphic actor-type filtering, clients should check domain-specific status event schemas or the actor_type property if present.

start_date.description: Filter for earliest transition timestamp (ISO 8601 format). Inclusive. Optional.

end_date.description: Filter for latest transition timestamp (ISO 8601 format). Inclusive. Optional.
